div.div:
• Single-Receiver Semantics: Exactly one worker processes each item
• Dynamic Load Balancing: Workers pull at their autonomous rate
• Post-Ack Deletion: Message purged upon consumer acknowledgement
• Realization: AWS SQS Standard, RabbitMQ Direct Work Queues

div.div:
• Durability Guarantee: fsync barrier flushes OS buffer to non-volatile disk
• Split-Brain Protection: Quorum intersection guarantees zero state loss
• Consequence: Guarantees At-Least-Once delivery; duplicates inevitable
• Realization: Kafka min.insync.replicas=2, RabbitMQ quorum queues

div.div:
• One-to-Many Broadcast: Each consumer group receives identical stream
• Consumer Independence: Slow consumer never blocks peers
• Non-Destructive Reads: Replayable streams tracked by consumer offset
• Realization: Apache Kafka Topics, Google Cloud Pub/Sub, AWS SNS

div.div:
Enterprise Invariant Summary:
• Decoupled Transmission: Producers address logical channels without binding to consumer scale, topology, or operational uptime.
• Storage Persistence: Durability is enforced via fsync write-ahead logs and majority replica quorums before producer acknowledgement.
• Deterministic Triage: Unrecoverable syntax errors bypass retry loops directly to Invalid Message Channels, while transient semantic failures exhaust backoff budgets before containment in Dead Letter Channels.
